name: gdx-viewer
description: View, dump and compare GAMS GDX files using gdxdump/gdxdiff from GAMS or the GAMSPy CLI.

enumDescriptions: Use the GAMS gdxdump/gdxdiff executables if a GAMS system is found, otherwise fall back to the GAMSPy CLI.
Always use gdxdump/gdxdiff from a GAMS system directory.
Always use `gamspy gdx dump` / `gamspy gdx diff`.
gdx.backend.description: Which tools to use for reading and comparing GDX files.

gdx.gamsSystemDirectory.description: GAMS system directory containing gdxdump and gdxdiff. If empty, the PATH and common install locations are searched.

gdx.gamspyExecutable.description: Path to the gamspy executable. If empty, a .venv in the workspace folders and then the PATH are searched.

gdx.maxRowsPerPage.description: Number of records (list view) or rows (table view) shown per page in the GDX viewer.

gdx.maxColumnsPerPage.description: Number of columns shown per page in the table view of the GDX viewer.

enumDescriptions: Automatic: fixed notation for numbers of moderate size, scientific notation otherwise; the precision is the number of significant digits.
Fixed notation; the precision is the number of decimals (0-14). Very large numbers use scientific notation.
Scientific notation; the precision is the number of significant digits.
gdx.numberFormat.style.markdownDescription: Default format of numbers in the GDX viewer and the comparison view. Each symbol's format can be changed with *Format* in the viewer.

gdx.numberFormat.precision.markdownDescription: Default precision: significant digits (1-17) for the `g` and `e` formats, decimals (0-14) for `f`.

gdx.numberFormat.fullPrecision.markdownDescription: Show the fewest digits that reproduce the stored values exactly (`g` and `e` formats), instead of `#gdx.numberFormat.precision#`.

gdx.numberFormat.squeezeTrailingZeros.description: Remove trailing zeros after the decimal point.

gdx.rememberViewState.markdownDescription: Remember the view of each GDX file (selected symbol and, per symbol, filters, sorting, fields, layout and number format) after it is closed. A symbol's view is kept while its type and dimension stay the same. *GDX: Reset Viewer State* forgets the view of a file.

gdx.squeezeDefaults.markdownDescription: Hide the fields of variables and equations (level, marginal, bounds, scale) that have their default value in every record. Can be changed per symbol with *Fields*.

enumDescriptions: Use the decimal separator of the system language
gdx.copy.decimalSeparator.description: Decimal separator of numbers copied from the GDX viewer and the comparison view (the displayed values are not affected).

gdx.diff.eps.description: Absolute tolerance used by gdxdiff (Eps). 0 uses the tool default.

gdx.diff.relEps.description: Relative tolerance used by gdxdiff (RelEps). 0 uses the tool default.

gdx.diff.compareDomains.description: Let gdxdiff also compare the domains of symbols (CmpDomains).

gdx.diff.ignoreSetText.description: Let gdxdiff ignore the explanatory texts of set elements (SetDesc=N).

gdx.diff.compareDefaults.description: Let gdxdiff report default values (e.g. 0 for parameters) found in only one file as differences (CmpDefaults).

gdx.diff.ignoreOrder.description: Let gdxdiff ignore the UEL order of the input files (IgnoreOrder).
